phrase: john maynard keynes is considered the initiator of macroeconomics when he published his work the general theory of employment, interest, and money in 1936. macroeconomics, as a separate field of research and study, is generally recognized to have begun with the publication of john maynard keynes 's the general theory of employment, interest, and money in 1936.
